title: Product photo of the scope of supply
body_md: The photo shows all parts side by side on a white background: the quick guide as an opened booklet, the rod-shaped antenna, the black device housing, two small blue connectors, a flat fuse, two blue fuse holders, two screws, a black cable with a modular plug, and a multi-coloured wiring harness with a white connector housing. The parts are **not** numbered in the photo; they can only be matched to the list by shape and colour.
source_region: Page “Scope of supply”, product photo in the upper third
prev_context: The intended use ends on the previous page.
next_context: The numbered list of nine items follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 6: identical, unchanged photo without a caption. The missing numbering is therefore a property of the shared template, not a language difference, and it is an accessibility limit because the match remains purely visual.
